summary: The registrant filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce a routine monthly base distribution declared by its Board of Directors. The distribution targets a 10.0% annualized rate based on prior-quarter NAV, with a $0.03655 per-share payment for Class A and Class I shares, record date May 29, 2026, and payment date June 5, 2026. The filing includes standard cautionary language about tax attributes and funding sources. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, restructuring, or tender offer—is present. The filing is a normal periodic distribution announcement.
